heading: Thursday
text: Passing clouds in the St. Lawrence and border communities, high clouds receding from the lower Greens and New Hampshire, remaining mostly sunny west until this evening, Highs in the 50s north to south, low 60s in southern valleys. Gusty north winds.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Perhaps an early sprinkle in the northern mountains. Becoming clear and crisp. Lows in the mid 20s to low 30. Winds subsiding 5 to 10 mph. North winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 20 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Friday
text: Mostly sunny but brisk. Highs from the mid 40s to lower 50s north, and upper 40s to mid 50s in the south. North winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph.
